en.title: PlayStation Plus Drops Major PS5 Blockbusters and PS2 Gems for July
en.summary: Get ready to expand your PlayStation library! Sony has officially unveiled the July 2026 PlayStation Plus Game Catalog, headlined by two highly anticipated PS5 titles and a pair of beloved PS2 classics.
en.body:
The wait is over for PlayStation Plus subscribers eager to know what's new in the Game Catalog for July 2026. Sony has confirmed a robust selection of titles, with **Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora** and **Rise of the Ronin** leading the charge on PS5. This addition of two major, relatively recent releases demonstrates Sony's continued commitment to populating the Extra and Premium tiers with significant gaming experiences.

Alongside these blockbusters, players can also dive into the past with two classic PS2 titles joining the Premium tier: **Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy** and **Indigo Prophecy**. These games offer a dose of nostalgia and a chance for newer players to experience influential titles from a bygone era. The staggered release schedule, with some games available from July 15th in the US and UK, and the full lineup rolling out globally on July 21st, means early access for some regions, while others will need to wait just a little longer.

## A Diverse Digital Playground

Beyond the headliners, the July lineup continues to impress with variety. **Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora** brings players to the vibrant and dangerous world of Pandora, offering an open-world adventure that fans have been eager to explore. **Rise of the Ronin**, a PlayStation exclusive from Team Ninja, provides a deep action-RPG experience set in a tumultuous period of Japanese history. For those seeking more action, **Dying Light** on PS4 offers intense zombie survival gameplay, while **Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind** on PS5 and PS4 promises a retro-inspired beat 'em up experience.

Supporting titles like **Firefighting Simulator: Ignite** and **Snow Bros. Wonderland** add further breadth to the catalog, ensuring there's something for every taste. It's also worth noting that **Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector** will be available, offering a narrative-driven experience for fans of indie darlings. This curated selection highlights Sony's strategy of blending recent hits with enduring favorites and niche gems.

## What This Means for Subscribers

The inclusion of **Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora** and **Rise of the Ronin** is particularly significant. These are titles that many players may have skipped at launch, making their inclusion in the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog a fantastic value proposition. For subscribers, this means gaining access to critically acclaimed and popular games without an additional purchase, further solidifying the benefits of the Extra and Premium tiers. The addition of classic PS2 titles also appeals to long-time PlayStation fans, offering a taste of gaming history.

## What's Next

While the July lineup is packed, gamers will be keeping an eye on what titles might be leaving the catalog soon, as new additions often signal departures. Specific details on games departing the service have not yet been announced, but subscribers should prepare for potential changes.

content_raw: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog for July 2026, which is headlined by Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora, Rise of the Ronin, and two PS2 classics. It’s worth remembering that Sony is still experimenting with the timing of new PS Plus game releases, which means the games will be released on varying dates throughout the month in the U.S., the UK and Japan. The full lineup will be available to play on July 21 in all other regions. Here’s the lineup, courtesy of the PlayStation Blog .
